extraction.agency_name: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services
extraction.parent_department: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services

findings.title: The Region Had Not Fully Reconciled its Inmate Fund
findings.description: Jessup and ECI Offices had not fully reconciled inmate fund records with Comptroller records; last reconciliation was July 2014 prior to new system implementation. Significant differences existed ($182,000 Jessup, $64,000 ECI) unresolved since August 2014 due to inability to obtain reports from MOBSII.
findings.recommendation: Work with DPSCS Office of Secretary to obtain reports; reconcile MOBSII balances timely and resolve differences; consult Comptroller/DBM on disposition if unresolved.

findings.title: Controls Were Lacking Over Certain Inmate Fund Transactions and Records
findings.description: Jessup Office lacked controls; transactions not independently reviewed, user access not restricted (incompatible duties), checking account unreconciled since April 2014.
findings.recommendation: Independently review transactions; restrict user access; ensure monthly reconciliations timely.

findings.title: The Region Made Repeated Purchases From Two Vendors Without Competitive Bids and Written Contracts
findings.description: Region made frequent purchases of fresh produce from two vendors without consolidating/bidding or contracts during FY 2012-2014. Jessup $2M, ECI $652k. State regulations require competitive procurement for amounts >$5k.

dollar_amounts.context: Jessup Office payments to two vendors
ECI Office payments to two vendors

findings.recommendation: Comply with regulations; competitively procure fresh produce; execute written contracts and obtain DGS approval.

findings.title: A Management Employee Was In a Position to Influence the Region’s Decision to Hire an Immediate Family Member
findings.description: Management employee influenced hiring of family member as contractual employee in their unit without recruitment/interview process. Potential ethics violation and noncompliance with personnel laws. Earnings totaled $28,000 by May 19, 2015.

dollar_amounts.context: Contractual employee earnings as of May 19, 2015

findings.recommendation: Refer matter to State Ethics Commission; comply with laws/policies in future.

findings.title: Procedures and Controls Over Overtime Payments and Leave Recordkeeping Need Improvement
findings.description: Ineligible employees paid overtime ($16,350 based on tests); compensatory leave balances exceeded maximums (2,080 hours excess).

dollar_amounts.context: Total improper overtime payments based on tests

findings.recommendation: Enhance review procedures; establish controls for leave balances; investigate and take action.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The agency agreed to recommendations for Findings 1, 2, and 3 with specified completion dates. For Finding 4, the text lists contacts but does not explicitly state agreement or a date in the provided appendix section.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date inferred as October 1, 2015 based on 'October 2015' header. Audit period covers South Region July 1, 2012 to June 30, 2014. Finding 1 marked repeat with asterisk and text confirmation. Finding 4 referral is to State Ethics Commission, not Attorney General Criminal Division.
